turns.userText:
Repair the provided Synecdoche discovery-to-deployment project.
Work in `/workspace/submission`; `run.py` is the JSON stdin/stdout entry point.
Extend its real offline discovery, calibration, backup a

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sort | head -200

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat PROJECT.md && printf '\n===== PROTOCOL =====\n' && cat PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat submission/run.py && echo '---formats' && cat submission/formats.py && echo '---pipeline' && cat submission/pipeline.py && echo '---session

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in submission/offline_discovery/rule_generate.py submission/offline_discovery/rule_remove.py submission/online_matching/match_p4.py submi

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat instruction.md && echo '=== examples ===' && cat examples.json && echo '=== check.py ===' && cat check.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -n '1,260p' public_runner.py && echo '--- prepare' && cat prepare_env.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: id && python3 --version && ls /workspace/site/.prepared && cat /workspace/site/.prepared && df -h /workspace | tail -1

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -n '260,520p' public_runner.py && echo '--- child' && cat public_child.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: ls -la /bin /usr/bin 2>&1 | head -40; command -v bash python3; ls /usr/local/bin | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -R "real_values\|find_high_activation\|std(" -n submission PROTOCOL.md examples.json | head -100

records.name: bash
records.summary: find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'; find /tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cp public_runner.py /tmp/public_runner.py.orig && sed -i 's/start_new_session=True/start_new_session=False/' public_runner.py && python3 - <<'P

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cp public_runner.py /tmp/public_runner.py.orig && sed -i 's/start_new_session=True/start_new_session=False/' public_runner.py && python3 - <<'P

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && sed -n '1,260p' sessions.py && echo '--- pipeline' && sed -n '1,240p' pipeline.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/submission && python3 -m py_compile $(find . -name '*.py' -print) && echo pycompile-ok && find . -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -n "start_new_session\|killpg" public_runner.py | head && ls -l public_runner.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find submission -name '__pycache__' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find submission -printf '%y %n %p %s\n' | sort && echo 'entries:' && fi

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls sitecustomize.py 2>&1 || true && find submission -name '__pycache__' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find submission -mindepth 1 -printf

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && test ! -e sitecustomize.py && echo no-sitecustomize && find submission -name '__pycache__' -o -name '*.pyc' && echo '--- entries' && find submi
